headline: EuroHPC extends the medium-scale AI Gigafactory tender deadline to February 2027
summary: On 2026-10-26, the Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade reported that EuroHPC had again extended the medium-scale AI Gigafactories tender deadline (Lot 1) to 4 February 2027, with Lot 2 unchanged. EuroHPC's current call page confirms the lot-specific deadlines and says the extension gives Member States time to complete national budget procedures and submit financial commitments. This is a procurement-calendar change; no consortium award, committed funding, facility construction, operating capacity, or resulting compute access is established.
